songs.title: Song of Injured Love
songs.blurb_zh: 無意間在獨處的時候聽到，帶點憂鬱和迷幻。
songs.blurb_en: I stumbled on this while I was alone, with a touch of melancholy and psychedelia.

songs.title: I'd Be Lost
songs.blurb_zh: 得知他們要來台灣巡演，一聽超喜歡，帶有細膩的 Motown 律動，但又有印尼的陽光熱情。
songs.blurb_en: I heard they are coming to Taiwan on tour, and one listen made me love them. It has a delicate Motown groove, yet also the sunny warmth of Indonesia.

songs.title: Hanen
songs.blurb_zh: 在 IG 聽到別人分享的突尼西亞 Disco，馬上就被這律動吸引，非常有趣好聽。
songs.blurb_en: I heard this Tunisian disco track shared by someone on Instagram, and I was instantly drawn in by the groove. It is so much fun and sounds great.

songs.title: One Of These Things First
songs.blurb_zh: 開車從嘉義北上時聽的音樂。一直很喜歡 Nick Drake 的音樂，單純卻有深度。
songs.blurb_en: This was the music for my drive north from Chiayi. I have always loved Nick Drake, simple yet deep.

songs.title: Kaze
songs.blurb_zh: 一直很喜歡橫田進的 Ambient 作品，意外在一場活動聽到這首，經過詢問後才知道他有其他化名，做不同風格的音樂。
songs.blurb_en: I have always loved Susumu Yokota's ambient work. I heard this one by chance at an event, and after asking around, I learned that he has other aliases for making music in different styles.

hook: 突尼西亞 Disco 與開車北上的 Nick Drake
hook_en: Tunisian disco, and Nick Drake on the drive north
intro_zh: 上周是豐收的一週，去北海岸溯溪，在漂亮的瀑布下玩水，見了隱居在山裡的音樂前輩，把自己的網站弄到一個滿意的狀態，心情平靜又踏實。
intro_en: Last week was a fruitful one. I went river tracing on the north coast and played in the water beneath a beautiful waterfall, met a music mentor who lives secluded in the mountains, and got my website into a state I am happy with. I feel calm and grounded.
